summary.environment: Static Source Code & Architecture Security Audit

findings.title: Known vulnerabilities in package dependencies requiring breaking major upgrades
findings.description: Audit discovered packages requiring major framework upgrades (next@16.4.3, ai@7, shadcn@1.0.0, and unpatched upstream xlsx)
findings.evidence: Audit reported 26 total vulnerabilities (2 critical, 18 high, 5 moderate, 1 low)
findings.remediation: Monitor upstream security patches; schedule coordinated major framework migration

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Compatible Policy Recommendation
findings.description: Current response headers lack an explicit Content-Security-Policy header restriction. A production-ready, compatible policy has been formulated based on actual runtime needs (Supabase Auth/WebSockets, Google Gemini streaming, Next.js inline scripts).
findings.evidence: Evaluation of runtime network dependencies: https://*.supabase.co, wss://*.supabase.co, https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com
findings.reproduction: Inspect headers returned from Next.js server
findings.impact: Defense-in-depth mitigation against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and unauthorized data egress
findings.remediation: Deploy compatible CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.supabase.co; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com https://api.resend.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; frame-ancestors 'none';

checks.expectedResult: Server verifies Bearer tokens with auth.getUser(token) and rejects unauthenticated callers
checks.actualResult: Verified server extracts and cryptographically validates Bearer tokens

checks.expectedResult: Server explicitly queries Supabase Auth to verify token signature and validity
checks.actualResult: Server explicitly verifies token via auth.getUser(token)

checks.expectedResult: Enforces minimum 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols
checks.actualResult: Password strength criteria enforced across length, casing, numbers, and symbols

checks.testCase: Dataset CRUD & Actions Enforce user_id Filtering
checks.expectedResult: All dataset operations filter explicitly by eq("user_id", user.id)
checks.actualResult: Verified all dataset routes strictly enforce user ownership checks

checks.testCase: Private Storage Path Prefixed by User ID
checks.actualResult: Storage path enforces datasets/${user.id} namespace isolation

checks.expectedResult: Uses authenticated cipher aes-256-gcm with 16-byte tag preventing ciphertext tampering
checks.actualResult: Cipher uses AES-256-GCM with authenticated verification tag and unique IV per encryption

checks.testCase: Dataset File Extension & Payload Boundary Limits
checks.expectedResult: Validates allowed extensions (.csv, .xlsx) and enforces max file size
checks.actualResult: File validation enforces allowed MIME types and upload size boundaries

checks.testCase: Zero Server Secrets in Mobile Source Code
checks.expectedResult: No GEMINI_API_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, or DB passwords in mobile/
checks.actualResult: Mobile application clean: 0 private server secrets found in source tree

checks.expectedResult: Config loader reads only EXPO_PUBLIC_ prefixed environment variables
checks.actualResult: Verified config.ts accesses exclusively public EXPO_PUBLIC_* variables

checks.expectedResult: Enforces X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy, and X-XSS-Protection
checks.actualResult: All 4 defense-in-depth security headers enforced in lib/supabase/middleware.ts
